verdict.rationale: Homebrew is a locally run CLI. Its documented tap mechanism accepts any Git URL, and taps can supply their own bottles, so users can host their own formula and binary repositories. A community report confirms this works but says it needs a full git server rather than a static CDN host. missing for 10: documented self-hosting or mirroring of the core homebrew-core/cask repositories and the JSON API, a static-host-friendly tap option, and an end-to-end self-hosting guide.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: The one-argument form assumes a repository on GitHub, while the two-argument form accepts any URL supported by Git.
This may be useful for taps that wish to provide bottles for their formulae or cater to a non-default HOMEBREW_CELLAR.
